story_chat_messages_visibility_role_chec.name: story_chat_messages_visibility_role_check
story_chat_messages_visibility_role_chec.value:
CASE
          WHEN "story_chat_messages"."is_visible" = 0 THEN "story_chat_messages"."role" = 'system'
          ELSE "story_chat_messages"."role" IN ('user', 'assistant')
        END

studio_plan_items_tension_check.name: studio_plan_items_tension_check
studio_plan_items_tension_check.value: "studio_plan_items"."tension" IS NULL OR ("studio_plan_items"."kind" = 'chapter' AND "studio_plan_items"."tension" BETWEEN 1 AND 10)
